$comment: Source of truth for agent roles and skills. Edit .agents/; sync-agents generates tool files and --check verifies them. Codex discovers .agents/skills directly; .agents/codex/ supplies shared instructions and lifecycle hooks. Tiers set reasoning budgets, not price tiers; null model inherits the selected model. T0 is scripts and never a model. exclude: folders whose AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files are not checked (read-only templates or vendored code).
